source: MIT Markov switching / Hamilton (1989) regime models
references: Kim & Nelson (1999) MIT Press — State-Space Models with Regime Switching
concepts: Latent state S_t follows a first-order Markov chain with transition matrix P
Regime persistence: diagonal of P should be high (markets stay in a regime)
Emissions: mean/vol parameters differ per state; filter gives P(S_t | data)
Use P(stress) and transition risk to throttle entries, not to predict price
